avis.titre: Beware if you have acne-prone/sensitive skin
avis.texte: I wanted to love this product! I've been using it a few times a month for a year now. Everytime I use it, I wake up with tiny whiteheads on my cheeks that take over a week to go away & irritated skin. I am 21 years old & have combo skin with light acne that comes and goes based on new products I try. For some reason I kept using this product in hopes of it working. I would wait for my skin to clear to use it again and the same process would keep happening over and over literally for months now. I'm giving up on it & now using products that I know calm my skin because there are plenty of other options. I really wanted this to be my holy grail serum for the price I paid, but It turns out there are products that clear up my skin and make my skin glowy for 1/5th of the price.
I don't get the hype. If your skin is dry then it burns and my skin doesn't look any different the next day. I want to love it but I just don't.

I use this every other night after cleansing and toning my face. It does help reduce acne scars and other discoloration but it isn't as effective as I hope it would be.

I'm 35 weeks pregnant and I thought I was safe from stretch marks because my mom and grandmother didn't get any during their pregnancies, but I noticed them starting to form at 32 weeks and I was devastated. I'd been religiously applying lotion with vitamin E day and night since my first trimester so I felt really bad. I decided to rub this serum over my forming stretch marks (in addition to the lotion) as it hydrates the skin and helps reduce scarring (that's what stretch marks are, after all). I didn't expect to see a dramatic reduction in my stretch marks after TWO DAYS, and my husband agrees. Don't get me wrong, they're still there, but they're closer to my skin color and harder to see as opposed to the reddish color that they were. I know this is a strange way to use this products and it was made to be used on the face but I just had to mention it in. I still find it pricey but it's pennies compared to laser removal or cover-up tattoos. I must sound vain right now but I've suffered from body image issues since I was a teen and the stretch marks were taking a mental toll on me but this serum might've helped restore my sanity and I think that deserves 5 stars.

avis.titre: This was my favorite vitamin C serum they changed formula
avis.texte: They changed the formula and added ingredients like castor oil as a woman I don't want hair follicle growth inducing ingredients in my vitamin C serum the old formula was perfect they should go back to it

I've been using Mario Badescu Vitamin C Serum for over a year now. I absolutely love this product. It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and in conjunction with prescription acne meds has cleared up my cystic acne and discoloration.

I use this every night and notice the difference immediately when I wake up. My skin looks more refreshed and the dark spot lighter with each use. I get acne monthly with my monthly visiter and this helps get rid off my dark spot from my visiter lol. Over all my skin look less dull and brighter. I have combination skin.

Can't say enough good things about this product. I pair it with a few The Ordinary products and my skin has never looked better. I've had forehead wrinkles since I was a teen, over the years and lack of proper skin care, the wrinkles have deepened greatly. However, after a few months of using this, the ordinary hyaluronic acid, nightly lactic acid, my skin does not only look much better, but it feels better. My skin is much more brighter and teen years of not taking proper care have almost vanished with using these products. I would HIGHLY recommend this product to anyone who has wrinkles and that neglected their skin. It's made a huge difference in my skin, I feel so much more confident about my skin, and overall extremely happy with this product.

While this product gets good ratings overall, I just felt it needed an extra "shout out." I have tried various C serums - and I decided to give the Mario B a try. I'm glad I did! One thing people forget, that is that Mario Badescu DOES SKIN and isn't in the beauty game, as so many of the other makers of all things cream, serum, etc., are. So I trust that his products do what they claim. Like others, I use mine in the morning, so that I do not have to discontinue/skip my retinol cream at night. The serum feels thicker than many others when you apply it - and the ONLY con is that you have to work fast to rub it in, otherwise it doesn't spread as easily. The smell is refreshing - a bit like a tree tree oil. NOT perfumey. It takes about five minutes for it to fully sink in, and then viola! Your face will look wonderful. It has an ever so slight tingly feeling that goes away after fifteen minutes or so, but it leaves no redness. I love what it is doing for my skin, and I trust this brand. I cannot stress it enough - this product is coming from a purely skin care line that is not involved with beauty - just better skin. Another quality product from Mario B!

This product says to use nightly, but I have been using it during the daytime and I love what it does for my skin. One large acne mark on my cheek looked significantly better within a few days of wearing this. It feels a bit oily when I am applying it, but my skins soaks it right up and it wears very well under makeup

I've had problem skin my entire life, 30s hit and now it's sensitive and I'm showing wrinkles. This product along with the orange face wash and a vitamin c cream makes me look and feel in my 20s again! It's a holy grail product.

I bought & began using this in September. I've used it every other night and am about half way through the bottle, so even though it's not cheap it does last awhile. But I have noticed zero change in my skin. Not a thing.

I apply it in the morning. Let it set and then apply moisturizer with hyaluronic acid before applying makeup. I'm a nurse and wear a mask every day and it has helped reduce "maskne" and decreased the redness associated with breakouts. I have sensitive skin and was able to use this product with no issues.
I use this serum after I tone and before I apply moisturizer. It goes on so smooth and I feel that it enhances, brightens and rejuvenates my maturing skin! I've purchased at least twice now.

I use this serum every morning! After 2 weeks, I noticed the texture of my skin had really improved. I have a lot of allergies to products causing breakouts, but this one seems to be golden- no reaction.

avis.titre: This is not it, do not buy!
avis.texte: I was very disappointed by how dry and irritated my skin became for DAYS after using this product. I am NOT new to vitamin c serums and have used multiple bottles of different 20% vitamin c concentrates and I have never had a problem. This was the most drying product I have ever used. I'm assuming it is because of the lavender oil in it, which has been known to not be the best for skin. Literally my skin was flaky and irritated after using the recommended amount. At first I thought maybe I just need to get use to it. So I applied it about three days apart three times, but every time was worse than the last. Also it is very greasy and I didn't like the texture of it, smelled nice though!
Didn't feel great going on; didn't see much improvement from using. For the price, there are better options.

My boyfriend had got this for me for my birthday and I absolutely love it. The serum dramatically hydrates my skin leaving me feel refreshed. I also have scarring on my cheeks from cystic acne, and it has dramatically Improved and filled in my scar Imperfections. (Crater like scarring from Cystic acne). This has also improved and even skin tone for my complexion as well. The serum spreads very easily so you do not need a lot, although it is kind of on the thicker side and takes a little bit longer to dry (stays on kinda sticky for a while) So I recommend after cleansing and toning apply to your face at night but give yourself some time before you Go to bed as it is still sticky and may rub off on your pillow or sheets

I use this product at night. I like the feel, it's not greasy and absorbs well. I think it has a nice fragrance, I've used other brands before that smell like dog food and are quite expensive. I believe it's helpful on the war on wrinkles.
I love this product. It has completely transformed my skin. I no longer have dark spots or acne scars. My face is brighter and healthier. I use this with other serums but this one is a must have!

I've been using this serum for a year a few times a week before bed to prevent anti aging, although im still young enough to not notice wrinkles but i feel this serum helps alot. i just purchased my 2nd bottle and I will keep repurchasing. I love this brand and I had high hopes for this serum and it did not disappoint.

This is probably my third bottle. I love this serum! I use it at night and my face is glowing in the mornings! Thank

avis.titre: Great product and price, bad packaging
avis.texte: The contents of the serum is great. It works relatively fast by reducing breakouts and redness while maintaining moisture and balance to the skin. I actually enjoy the scent, but it's relatively strong smelling of lavender oil. The only thing that frustrates me with this product is the packing. The lid does twists on, but it doesn't keep the tension, meaning that if you travel or knock it over, it could leak and drain the contents. I have actually purchased two bottles of this this and my first one leaked and fully saturated a bag while traveling. The second bottle only got temporarily knocked over and only lost a little bit. I think I will purchase this again because it's a better price than most vitamin c serums and does the job it's intended for, but I just won't travel with it. Overall, I recommend it, but make sure you store it upright at all times.

I bought this serum about 3 months ago and I love it.I usually give it awhile to see if I really see any results I'm olny 20 years old with oliy skin with some trouble of acne scars. It doesn't spread easily and leaves my skin with a burning sensation. I've never had a serum do that.

there is a lot of smack talked about mario badescu because some of their products are very good ingredient wise. but this product doesn't have any bad ingredients in it except for lavender oil. it makes my skin look younger and brightened. totally recommend

avis.titre: Best skincare product I have ever used

I had run out and had a bad stress breakout because I recently moved to another state. I went and got this and within 2 uses all the breakouts were gone. It does a great job at making skin really smooth. The texture can take some getting used to. It's a little slimy/sticky. However it sinks into skin fast. I've tried other vitamin c serums for less money but nothing compares to this one! It is my holy grail!
This product broke me out terribly. I would stay away if you have oily skin.

avis.auteur: The go-to review for those curious
avis.titre: The only vitamin c serum in my eyes
avis.texte: So first I'll say, I'm still on my first bottle. But it's been well over a year and I bought two back ups in both the sales that occurred during that time so I may actually never run out and I'm good with that. I didn't even know that vitamin c serums smell bad because this was my first and it smells like lavender and orange oil. I actually have switched it up a couple times for about a week each just to see if there's something better out there, other good ones are good but they're just not this one. It's the most gentle and the most nice smelling and it genuinely heals damage to the skin (acne, redness, dryness, etc) put it on while your skin is warm and moist before your moisturizer and after your toner if you use it (and buy it during the beauty steals like I do, it's half off!! Can't beat it) Three or four drops will do you beautifully, it is not meant to be a moisturizer so don't load up your face with a handful of this serum or you'll just waste it as your face cannot absorb that much product or vitamin C.
I've been consistently using this serum for about a week and already have noticed a difference my skin tone and texture. Will definitely keep this product in my skincare routine
Honestly this god sent serum improved significantly my skin texture and pores . This is my third bottle. I loooove this product. The best vit c serum!!!

This product was recommend to me by an RN because I suffered from a chemical burn on my cheek. After the burn healed, this serum was applied nightly to brighten my skin and fade the remaining dark spots... to my surprise, that's exactly what it did! I still have a bit to go with the mark, but honestly... I dont think I've would confidently achieve these results without this product.

This product smells really good, and so far o think it's working pretty well. It's just too liquidy though. I put it in my hand to rub on my face, but I feel like so much runs through my fingers and doesn't make it on my face because of the consistency
I mix this with my moisturizer and noticed a difference after a week. My skin is extra sensitive and I've had no issues. This is not an oil, but truly a serum. Thank you Mario
It made my very irritated, swollen, and red. I don't recommend if you have sensitive skin

avis.titre: Something that finally works for my sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I rarely leave reviews, but this serum really impressed me. I have very sensitive skin (sometimes textured in places), dry and acne prone skin making it hard to find products that can keep the acne at bay without over drying. I got this in a sample bag from Ulta and have been using for about 2 weeks now. I already have a full size bottle on the way! This serum has not only started to clear up my sporadic acne, but it's starting to lighten the awful scaring I have on my cheeks. I've noticed that my skin tone is more even and feels much smoother. The best part is that it's NOT super drying, I can't wait to see results after a few months of use. Also I use this every night even though the bottle says every other night!

avis.titre: Works for others but definitely not me
avis.texte: I have dry and sensitive skin and now love vitamin c products, however I applied this serum to my smile line area and ended up with what was like a chemical burn. My skin darkened, got so dry it peeled for 4 months, and after over a year since I bought it I'm still buying products to undo the damage caused by this product. I love this brand so I was very disappointed when this happened.

I used this once a day before my moisturizer. I normally have dry to oily skin. This product caused me to have one of the worst breakouts I've ever had. Once I stopped using it, my skin cleared up. It feels very oily on my skin. I do not recommend this product.

I decided to buy this serum because I saw many great reviews and I was looking for a AM brightening Vitamin C. After purchase, I began using everyday for over a week in the PM as indicated. I didn't see much results, the smell was not great either like herbal oil, not citrusy like most of the ones I've used before. You can only use at night time! I wouldn't recommend.
I can't tell a difference in my skin after using this product. It's very expensive for the lack of results.

I just started using this product about three weeks ago and I had really dark marks all over my face it seems to be lightening them the only con is that I can only use it every other day at night so I have to be sure that I don't get tired and I have to make sure I do my nighttime regimen.
Have been using this serum for years now. It helped fade away acne scars and gives my skin a natural glow! This is a must have in my skin care routine!
Absolutely love this serum. I don't use it every night but every other night. I wash my face and apply it. I don't use anything else with it either! It's reduced my breakouts and redness.

I do have acne prone skin and so far I haven't had any issues adding this serum to my skin care routine.

avis.titre: I continue to buy this product.

This serum goes on easily and leaves my skin feeling refreshed. I suffer from hormonal acne and I've found that this (in conjunction with some prescription acne meds) has calmed the number of breakouts and reduced redness.
This product has reduced the appearance of pimples and has helped to control my breakouts. It has also aided in brightening and evening out my complexion. I highly recommend it!
I've been using this for a year now and love it! I use it every night and every morning. I don't have aging skin, but hopefully this will prevent the aging.
This serum gives me the most beautiful glow, with wonderful moisture. It makes me skin so soft! This is the only Vitamin C Serum for me!!

I bought it expecting good results since everyone raves about it, but it did nothing for my skin( I have combo skin). I still use it in my night routine and plan to use it all but I wouldn't repurchase.
